user.title: StaggAssistant Setup
user.description: Find your kettle over Bluetooth, or enter its IP address manually.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Fellow Stagg EKG Pro.

bluetooth.title: Select your Stagg kettle
bluetooth.description: Make sure the kettle is powered and nearby. {device_count} kettle(s) found over Bluetooth. Selecting a kettle reads its IP address automatically.

error.invalid_auth: Device responds, but is not a Stagg EKG Pro.
error.invalid_ip: Invalid IP address or hostname format.
error.no_bluetooth_devices: No Stagg kettle was found over Bluetooth. Make sure the kettle is powered and your Home Assistant Bluetooth integration is working, or enter the IP address manually.
error.cannot_resolve_ip: The kettle was found over Bluetooth, but its IP address could not be determined. Try again, or enter the IP address manually.

init.title: StaggAssistant Options
init.description: Adjust integration settings, update the kettle's IP address, or rediscover it over Bluetooth.

settings.title: StaggAssistant Settings
settings.description:
Update the polling interval, extended entities, or the kettle's IP address.

⚠️ **Notice on extended entities:** On firmware 1.2.26+, Fellow blocks reading device settings over Wi-Fi. Extended switches, sliders, and sensors (hold duration, chime volume, boil temperature, schedule, altitude) rely on local optimistic caching and estimates, and are hidden by default to avoid 'Unknown' states.
